name: Three studies of figures and boats, Macau
summary: Three studies: a small boat at sea, with rudder raised and sail lowered, and two figures aboard; a porter carrying two baskets slung from a pole, and holding another pole in his right hand; and three boatwomen, of whom one stands on the shore as the other two bring a Tanka boat in towards her.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
